requested_outcome: Standalone lightweight modern-web browser on ordinary Win98SE and actual GPU acceleration on Shizuku Win98

fixture.kind: Independent representative assertions; not upstream WPT or full conformance
fixture.nonce: Fresh external ASCII run token,1..80 characters; bind to native launch and returned results

requirements: Bind exact externally approved origin including port,server hash,URL and nonce in native receipt
Query nonce alone does not establish approval or server ownership

presentation_controls: Actual native owned HWND and process
Native IO evidence for three trusted clicks plus text and Enter
Visible final page capture bound to source hashes and nonce
Unicode glyph appearance separately checked with exact font evidence
Machine-readable page result returned by genuine engine integration
fail_closed: No page errors or unhandled rejections
Same externally frozen source hashes,nonce and actual native process
Fixture page flags alone cannot prove native OS,engine identity,GPU or complete-web support

native_engine_proof.optional_extension: ZetscapeGetExtensionsV1 observations require actual native measurement; metadata is not GPU proof
required: Actual modern rendering/JSC provider compiled from frozen source
PE32 import closure against the exact native target baseline
Engine-created document/DOM/scripts/layout and native child HWND ownership
Exact module/source/archive/runtime/member hashes for linked engine
Callbacks quiesced and owned processes/windows cleaned on shutdown

ordinary_win98se.os: Actual Win98SE 4.10.2222; not spoofed version metadata
required: Fresh native run on an ordinary installation without Shizuku-only dependencies
Actual Win32 API behavior and all mandatory imports
Same required modern-web assertions with active backend recorded
ordinary_win98se.software_backend: Permitted if explicitly measured; cannot earn hardware acceptance

required: Actual Win98SE OS evidence on the Shizuku platform
Exact platform/kernel/display/GPU driver source commits and binary hashes
Real device identity and ownership,loaded modules and initialized context
Actual browser rendering/compositing command submission to that device
Visible native presentation of those rendered frames
Fresh software control and explicitly requested hardware run
No silent software fallback; failed hardware initialization is hardware FAIL
insufficient_evidence: A WebGL context or passing pixel fixture alone
CPU-rendered pixels copied to a GOP/framebuffer

requirements: Freeze full upstream commit,licenses,manifest and all test/support bytes
Expand selectors to a frozen exact ordered test-ID inventory
Run unmodified tests in actual Zetscape with actual target engine
Record testharness,reftest,manual and crash/hang results separately
Preserve wptreport,reference screenshots,run_info and actual browser binary hashes
Authorized local origins/HTTPS certificates only; no global host-file changes without explicit approval
All planned IDs accounted; timeouts,crashes,skips and harness failures remain visible
No injection of polyfills or fake engine APIs to manufacture acceptance

full_target.acceptance_rule: No 100% or complete modern-web claim from a representative fixture or WPT subset
required_before_full_target_verdict: Versioned finite specification/feature inventory and compatibility scope
Frozen complete WPT and ECMAScript test262 revision/manifest
Explicit denominator,all required test IDs and all subtest outcomes
Both actual platform runs,resource limits and driver/provider provenance
All unsupported or unimplemented features retained as gaps

DOM Unicode/normalization does not prove readable native glyphs; exact font/display evidence pending
